title: Site-Premium Addition for Lakefront and Greenbelt Sites — In-Place Home Resale Appraisals
content:
**Site premium.** The appraisal charge on an In-Place Home Resale file under the Guaranteed Resale Program carries a site-premium addition, added to the package's appraisal fee into the appraisal sum. The site-premium addition follows the lot class on the seller's Home-Site Lease, whose premium the appraiser supports with lot comparables: a Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site adds 60.00, a Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site adds 30.00, and any other lot class adds nothing.

| Lot class on the Home-Site Lease | Site-premium addition |
|---|---|
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 60.00 |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 30.00 |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 0.00 |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 0.00 |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 0.00 |
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 0.00 |
